xui_proxy_t.textMeasure.note: TextItem/font/text/context/language borrowed synchronously; temporary glyph run is freed before return. Managed Font stays pinned through the whole call.

xui_proxy_t.textDraw.note: Descriptor and text/context/language/spans consumed synchronously; managed Font pinned through the call. Deferred backend resources require Native owning references.

xui_proxy_t.drawText.note: Descriptor and text/context/language/spans consumed synchronously; managed Font pinned through the call. Deferred backend resources require Native owning references.

xui_proxy_t.drawPath.note: Path commands copied into temporary Shape, dash pattern copied by ShapeExStrokeDash, then temporary Shape destroyed before return.

xui_proxy_t.drawSvgPath.note: SVG CString parsed synchronously into temporary Shape; dash pattern copied; temporary Shape destroyed before return.

xui_proxy_t.drawTextSpans.note: Explicit paint spans borrowed only during synchronous Native draw; managed Font pinned through the call. Native backend owns any deferred drawing resources.
